name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $92, down 13% on the month as US–Iran talks continue; ships still being attacked near Hormuz
state: Brent was near $92 on 10 Nov, 13% lower on the month and inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). It fell about 2% to $96.4 early on 9 Nov after President Trump said he saw no reason to escalate and hoped for a deal with Iran, though Secretary of State Rubio called Iran's terms unacceptable (CBS News). Prices remain about 50% above pre-war levels, and no new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed this run.
for_you: Fuel and heating costs stay higher than before the Gulf war even as crude eases. Airlines, hauliers and energy-intensive firms remain most exposed to any renewed supply shock around Hormuz.

sources.title: CBS News — Live updates: Trump says US keeping Iran war at status quo

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
